item.title: SF mayor was 'worried' about 2 men on street, checked on them before bodyguard attack
item.description: Mayor Lurie's bodyguard was seen on the ground struggling with an individual. Seconds later, more police reinforcement arrived. One resident who wants to remain anonymous but shared a video of the incident, said the mayor went to get more help.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Sunny and warm, clear and comfortable for SF Chinese New Year Parade
item.description: Mild to start this weekend with warm temperatures this afternoon. Sunny with highs in the mid to upper 70s today. A few locations could reach 80.

item.title: After a president-filled celebration, Rev. Jesse Jackson's family gathers for a private homegoing
item.description: The private memorial service at the Rainbow PUSH Coalition's headquarters on the South Side of Chicago will include only a few hundred attendees, who are expected to be mostly family members, allies and confidants.

item.title: San Francisco's Chinatown community on edge after man stabbed in the back
item.description: Surveillance video obtained by ABC7 Eyewitness News shows the moment a man standing on a street corner is stabbed in the back. The video and the incident as a whole, are the talk of Chinatown.

item.title: CA health officials warning beachgoers of bird flu for pets after elephant seals contract virus
item.description: People and their canine companions are urged to be extra careful now at the beaches because of a new warning from the California Department of Public Health about bird flu.

item.title: Crowded race: 10 candidates officially running to be your next governor of California
item.description: Ten major candidates are officially in the running for California governor as of Friday, the filing deadline, marking what political observers say is the most competitive gubernatorial primary the state has seen in years.

item.title: Trump grieves with families during return of soldiers killed in war in the Middle East
item.description: President Donald Trump joined grieving families at Dover Air Force Base for the dignified transfer of six U.S. Army Reserve soldiers killed in Kuwait.

item.title: Oil and gas prices rapidly rise as Iran war shows no signs of letting up
item.description: The price of oil surged higher and showed no signs of halting its rapid climb a week after the U.S. and Israel launched major attacks on Iran that escalated into a war in the Middle East.

item.title: PHOTOS: 2026 San Francisco Chinese New Year Parade
item.description: Here's a look at some of the most memorable moments of the San Francisco Chinese New Year Parade as thousands flock to the city to watch the streets fill with dancing, floats and so much more.
